pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Charms passive and neutral creatures while making hostile mobs flee.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() all three Paths at level 10.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Bosses do not react to this ability. If $(l:abilities/presence)Presence$(/l) and Ghost Gaze are active at the same time, Ghost Gaze takes priority. $(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() all three Paths at level 10.
